item.title: A finished game can still be corrected for 7 days
item.summary: For 7 days after a two-player game ends, you can tell Murph in the game's group chat that you did a day you never posted, and the result, your record and the prize follow.
item.details: It works on your own days only, the same as during the game, and Murph says in the chat when the result changes. A recap already made keeps the result it was written from. After 7 days the result is final.
